purpose: Safety level vocabulary for profile and catalog metadata. This file is documentation metadata only and does not change runner behavior.

levels.notes: Used for planning documents and static catalog/profile files. It must not connect to devices or read private runtime config.

levels.description: Read-only inspection against a device or local evidence source.
levels.notes: Allows read-only SSH inspection in a future implementation, but no configuration changes, reboot, delete, reset, or live mutation.
Allows future read-only evidence collection and JSON/HTML/text reporting. It does not allow RouterOS add/set/remove, firewall changes, interface changes, reboot, or reset.

levels.description: Plan or validate actions without applying them.
levels.notes: May render planned checks or local reports, but must not apply configuration, connect to devices, or execute live commands.

levels.description: Live device action is explicitly blocked.
levels.notes: Use when a workflow or action must remain unavailable for live devices, including unsafe VRRP, firewall, interface, reboot, reset, or delete operations.
